spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Passage

** ¶6:** You ask well concerning this teaching . Attend and understand : The interior spiritual life that dwells within the external natural mind, when Divine Wisdom flows into it, is regener ated through the understanding of genuine truth and through the good of life lived according to that truth, and it is pur ified and becomes the new will — the regenerate person. In such a state there is no spiritual conflict within the interior life, no disorder of understanding , no ag itation of the will .

**¶7:** But when tem ptation ar ises and the person is thrown into spiritual conflict , this dist urbance enters into him first through his hered itary evil inclinations — the tend encies received from the spiritual lineage of his birth — which revol ve upon him and st ir him and ass ail him with conc upiscence and the eru ption of falsity against truth and with states of spiritual de solation and interior grief , each according to his ruling love . And likewise , according to his ruling love, the infl owing forces of the spiritual world ag itate him through the deep interior connections by which he is bound to the societies of that world.

**¶8:** At other times one may find that the inflowing forces from the spiritual world are ord erly and at rest with respect to a person, and yet a harmful element enters into him through what he has spiritu ally appropri ated — the doc trines he has consumed as n ourishment, or indeed the apparent truths he has received and made his own. In such a case, conflict and disorder and the eru ption of falsity increase within him, and concupiscence multipl ies upon him together with de solation and grief — all because the teachings he has taken in as the sust enance of his understanding and the tru ths he has received are laden with hidden fals ities, with a vind ictive persu asion conce aled within them. These enter into the external natural mind min gled with what he has appropri ated, and they conjoin themselves with the evils already dwelling in the natural will and with the inherited sin fulness present in him , activ ating and transm itting the eru ption of fals ity, the concupiscence, the de solation, and the grief — which are the evil deliber ations of the unre generate natural mind .

**¶9:** So that when you are spiritu ally troubled, know that it may come through the channels of infl ux and the deep connections to the spiritual societies above you — an overwhelming flood of falsity and evil pressing into you from that world.

**¶10:** There are other times, however, when the spiritual n ourishment that you appropriate is genuine and pure — when it is abundant in wisdom and in the life of charity , while the fals ity within it is slight , and the tendency toward evil is diminished from it. Even the general spiritual sphere surrounding you is calm , being purified; and the interior form of your mind is brought into peace and order, and what grows within you is multipl ied through the genuine goods contained in what you have appropriated. Then one finds you dwelling in spiritual rest and tran quility, for your interior states are well governed and in divine order, because the living element of charity predomin ates within you — predomin ates on account of the wisdom radi ating from those perf ected goods and truths that d well in your inter iors: those goods and truths whose work of formation is complete, whose spiritual obligations have been fulfilled, and whose life is free from anxiety . These have con joined themselves with the living goods and truths already present within you. Because of this you find them dwelling in you in deep peace , and they proceed out ward from you without conflict ; and your external natural life is found flour ishing in spiritual health. Your works are r ightly ordered, being well formed according to their proper pattern , and your understanding of doctrine is arranged in true sequence , and your speech acc ords with truth , and your interior spiritual life is free within you — ascending like a bird into the open air of rational freedom and heavenly understanding .

**¶11:** I have told you: when your external natural mind is disturbed, you are troubled through the channels of influx from below — the harmful fals ities that enter you through spiritual appropriation, through what you take in and make your own. But when the channels of influx from above are at peace with you, and what you have appropriated is clear and genuine , then your will is found r ightly ordered in its proper place, and all the deliber ations of your understanding rest in peace, free from the disturbance of fals ity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The soul that assumes the body, when the Light Mind will come to it, shall be purified by the power of wisdom and obedience, and it is cleansed and made a new man. There is no trouble in (the soul), nor confusion nor disturbance.

However, when a disturbance will arise for him and he will be troubled, this disturbance shall go into him in [two ways], first through his birth-signs and his difficult stars that [are appointed over him, and] they turn over him and stir him and trouble him with lust and anger and depression and grief, as he wills. Also, as he wills, the powers of heaven shall trouble him through their roots, to which he is attached.

Again, there are times you shall find the powers of heaven are peaceful and tranquil for him, and it comes to [pass that] a difficult part comes into him by the nourishment that he has eaten, or else indeed in some [drink] or in the water that they have drunk. Again, trouble and confusion and anger will increase in him, and lust multiplies upon him together with depression and grief; because of the nourishment of the bread he has eaten and the water he has drunk, which are full of bothersome parts, a vengeful counsel. They shall enter his body, [mixed in] with these foods, and they even become joined in with the wicked parts of the body and the sin that is in him; transferring the anger and the lust and the depression and the grief, these wicked thoughts of the body.
that should you be troubled [, it has come upon you from] them through the conduits and the roots of they above [you, as] the flood that comes into you.

There are times, however, if you shall find that the nourishment that comes into you is pure [and clean], so it is greater in light and life while the waste is less in it, and the evil-doing is diminished from it. Even the atmosphere above is still, being purified through the [light of the luminaries,] also the image is calmed from [all disturbance, and the good] increases in you through those good parts of the food that come into you. And they find you at ease and tranquil, as you are well governed in your abodes because of the living part, which is greater on account of the light of these justified souls that are in it. The ones that have perfected their deeds. Their dues have ceased, while their soul is carefree [and at rest, and] they have been allied with these living souls that [are p]resent in you. Due to this you shall find them in you, calm in tranquillity, and they come from you without trouble; and you are found flourishing of body. Even your deeds are determined, being well constructed after their manner, and your doctrines are in order, as your words [are ordered in truth, and] your soul is carefree within you, ascending like a bird.

When [your bo]dy is troubled, you shall be troubled by the conduits of they below, the difficult parts that come into you by food and the act of eating. Again, when the conduits above are calmed from you, even your food that has come into you is clear and pure. Your heart shall be found ordered in its place, your counsels at peace from disturbance.
